text:
Elena: heads up — since 03:10 we're seeing ~15% failures provisioning gpu nodes in eu-west-1. logs show keystore timeouts + fw denies to privatelink endpoint. any recent egress changes?
Raj: I rolled a firewall tightening at 03:05 (reduced ephemeral outbound to privatelink). Was trying to lock down an overly-broad rule. Did we forget egress allow for keystore endpoint? :grimacing: @sre-oncall
sre-oncall: noted, looking now. Can you paste the recent deny lines?
Elena: pasted snippet from instances trying to start: 
```
2026-03-20T03:11:02Z terraform-provisioner: ERROR keystore connect: dial tcp 10.12.34.56:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-20T03:11:02Z kernel: FIREWALL-DENY src=172.31.8.12 dst=10.12.34.56 dport=443 proto=TCP rule=egress-tighten-2026
```
Maya: that dst 10.12.34.56 is the privatelink keystore in eu-west-1-prod, right?
Raj: yes. I scoped the rule to only known control-plane CIDRs but forgot the node warm pool subnets. My bad.
Tom: landing a rollback or a targeted allow? we have a warmup backlog in the queue, nodes waiting ~6m each now. Cost/latency impact stacking.
Ana: ops-cost note: if warmpool delays >5m we start seeing scaled-up fallback on-host which increases spot spend. rough estimate +8% for this window.
Elena: for mitigation can we add a short-lived egress exception for keystore fqdn/IPs for 30m, then iterate? Prefer minimal blast radius.
Raj: pushing a temporary rule to allow 10.12.34.0/24 from warmpool subnets. will annotate change with rollback tag.
deploy-bot: change submitted by Raj at 03:18 UTC — Change ID CHG-20260320-1874 — applying firewall rule update to eu-west-1.
Elena: after change, 2/20 nodes still failing with keystore handshake refused (connection reset). s3 logs show retry 1-> backoff.
sre-oncall: collecting tcpdump from a failed instance. seeing TLS client hello but RST after 200ms. Could be keystore side rate-limit.
SecurityBot: FYI — keystore has an audit-window and per-source qps. We hit a soft throttle if too many concurrent new TLS sessions from one /20. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-qps
Maya: if it's a qps limit, adding more node parallelism will only make it worse. We should stagger retries and increase jitter on bootstrap.
Tom: immediate plan: 1) keep temporary egress allow 2) throttle parallel boots in warmpool controller (reduce concurrency from 12 -> 4) 3) add jitter 0-60s on retries 4) open keystore support ticket for audit-window exception.
Raj: implemented firewall rollback-ish and reduced warmpool concurrency flag. Pushed controller patch to reduce boot concurrency: `--warmpool-concurrency=4` (can revert).
Elena: thanks. Can someone open the keystore support ticket and cc security? I'll draft the audit log snippet.
Maya: opened ticket KS-4218 with logs and timestamps, cc'ed Security.
SecurityBot: acknowledged. Also reminder: any egress exception needs a 2hr max then automatic removal. Tag your change with `temp-egress-ttl`.
Raj: added tag `temp-egress-ttl=30m` to CHG-20260320-1874.
Elena: monitoring — provisioning success rate back to 94% after changes. keeping an eye for regressions. :eyes:
Ana: cost note: we recorded ~6% extra spot spend during the 25m incident window. I'll include in the weekly infra cost report.
Tom: follow-ups: (1) create a short playbook for keystore egress exceptions, (2) make warmpool controller respect keystore rate-limits dynamically, (3) verify audit logs captured the denied connections for the change review.
Elena: copying final action items into the incident doc. thanks all. :thumbsup:
